status: Fixed and verified in 2026-09-02 cleanup lane
finding: `next --claim` can create a second overlapping active write intent for the same actor without first advancing, coalescing, or preserving the earlier lease epoch. Broker then treats the earlier valid task as stale and blocks re-arbitration before queue admission.
expectedBehavior: Claim admission and Broker registration must be one atomic lifecycle: same-actor overlapping tasks either enter explicit per-surface queue order with both valid epochs, or the second claim fails before writing a conflicting intent.
evidenceOrRepro: Current `resolveSameActorClaimLaneSessionId` reuses the holding active-claim lane for the same actor in claim, renew, and release paths; a distinct lane remains a conflict only for a different actor. `packages/cli/src/commands/next/__tests__/claim-admission.spec.ts` and `tests/cli/lane-claim-conflict-matrix.test.ts` both pass on current HEAD, including same-actor lane reuse and different-actor rejection cases.
followUp: Keep the claim-admission and lane conflict-matrix regressions. The historical TASK-TEAM-0079 stale-epoch incident no longer represents current source behavior.
